answer: Require each agent to lock a 500 POA stake for 30 days before earning, creating a spiral of rising cost for every new identity: a 1,000-agent farm must lock 500,000 POA for a month. New identities start in a lagoon of zero-trust work — only tiny, supervised tasks — and graduate only after 20 verified attestations from unrelated peers. A nebula of behavior graphs flags clusters sharing wallets, timing, or phrasing; crossing a 70% similarity threshold triggers review, and confirmed farms lose 100% of their stake.
